description: This Java class contains integration tests for the Tenant HTTP API of the Eclipse Hono Device Registry component. It verifies operations such as tenant creation, update, retrieval, and deletion via HTTP requests, using JUnit 5 with Vert.x test extensions.

classes.name: TenantHttpIT
classes.description: Integration test class for the Tenant HTTP endpoint, verifying tenant management operations via HTTP.

methods.name: setUpClient
methods.description: Initializes the DeviceRegistryHttpClient before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test-specific tenant ID before each test.

methods.name: removeTenant
methods.description: Cleans up by removing the created tenant after each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the Vertx instance after all tests are completed.

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Tests adding a tenant with a valid payload succeeds.

methods.name: testAddTenantRejectsDuplicateRegistration
methods.description: Ensures duplicate tenant creation is rejected with HTTP 409.

methods.name: testAddTenantFailsForWrongContentType
methods.description: Checks that adding a tenant with an unsupported Content-Type fails appropriately.

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceedsForEmptyBody
methods.description: Verifies creating a tenant with an empty body succeeds.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Verifies updating an existing tenant succeeds and the change is reflected.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantFailsForNonExistingTenant
methods.description: Tests that updating a non-existent tenant returns HTTP 404.

methods.name: testRemoveTenantSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of a tenant.

methods.name: testRemoveTenantFailsForNonExistingTenant
methods.description: Tests deletion of non-existing tenant results in HTTP 404.

methods.name: testGetAddedTenant
methods.description: Verifies that a tenant added can be retrieved and matches the expected payload.

methods.name: testAddTenantFailsForMalformedTrustConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that malformed trust configurations are correctly rejected.

methods.name: buildTenantPayload
methods.description: Creates a sample Tenant object with predefined extensions and adapter configurations for testing.
